items.docs:
Deletes end-user Global Enterprise consent status for a property. In addition to the `siteId`, you will also need to include either the end-user's `globalcmpUUID` or `authId`.

This endpoint does not support mass deletions of end-user consent records. Please speak to your Sourcepoint representative to execute any mass deletions.
